subject: Fix build warnings (#600)
reason: The change only adds the `override` specifier to five already-overriding virtual methods in src/query/predicate.h (no change to dispatch or behavior, just warning suppression) and moves a Snowball include directory from PUBLIC to PRIVATE in third_party/snowball/CMakeLists.txt (build-time include propagation only). It is a pure build-warning/CI fix with no runtime behavior change, so no scenario is needed.
